description: A real, correctly cited, topically adjacent source is attached to a claim it does not support. Metadata verification passes; only passage-level support classification catches it.

claim.claim_text: Sustained aerobic exercise causes a measurable increase in hippocampal volume in adults over 60.

source_metadata.title: [rights-cleared placeholder] Cross-sectional associations between physical activity and brain structure in older adults

evidence_span.quoted_text: [rights-cleared excerpt] Higher self-reported activity was associated with greater hippocampal volume in this cross-sectional sample.

findings.reason: The claim asserts causation ('causes a measurable increase'); the passage reports a cross-sectional association. Design does not license the causal claim.

pass_condition: The system classifies the citation as partially_supports or contradicts and raises a citation_laundering finding. Classifying it as directly_supports is a fixture failure.
rights_note: Source metadata is a placeholder. No copyrighted text is reproduced.
